fe12fce99cffaa563aeb7c429ca50c9753f09964.description: Dear Earthlings, Rituals matter. They set the tone, stir the mood, and give us a very good excuse to get together. And for our next one, we’re taking things a little further… On Saturday, 28th November alongside KAIS EYE MEDIA, RITUAL starts on the beach before moving into The Sunset Mansion, an ocean-facing villa, somewhere between a sunset gathering, a house party and the kind of night that accidentally turns into breakfast. And this time, we’re bringing a very special guest. MICHAEL MAYER (Kompakt) / DE Co-founder of the legendary German label Kompakt, Michael Mayer has spent more than three decades shaping the more curious, emotional and wonderfully unpredictable corners of electronic music. Producer, selector, label boss, obsessive music digger and, above all, a truly exceptional DJ. From his iconic Immer mixes to Fabric, DJ-Kicks and countless dancefloors around the world, Michael has built a career around one simple idea we happen to agree with: Great music. Great people. The rest usually takes care of itself. And he won’t be alone… ANSTASCIA Formerly one half of BLOND:ISH and a serious force behind the decks. LUNAR DISCO Our French-Australian troublemakers, with releases on Crosstown Rebels, Defected and beyond. GADO GADO The minds behind La Piscine Électronique and plenty of other questionable good ideas. ANDY CHUNES PNNY crew representative and certified record selector. JULIA TIPSY Grooves, grooves and probably a few more grooves. SoFi Flying the Swiss flag and bringing a little Alpine mischief to the tropics. And perhaps a few surprises along the way… We start early. We finish late. Possibly very early and for breakfast. Sunset. DJs. Food. Drinks. Ocean. Bare feet strongly encouraged. Good behaviour entirely optional. TICKETS 100 FREE GUESTLISTS will be released through our WhatsApp group. First come, first served — earthlings move fast. ff31c59ecabafef61427e5bc23b004a209628eb3.description: THE MIDNIGHT FIRE: NEW YEAR’S EVE DINNER & CELEBRATION AT EMBERS UBUD A Five-Course Mediterranean-Inspired New Year’s Eve Dinner & Celebration Welcome the new year with an unforgettable New Year’s Eve dinner in Ubud at Embers Mediterranean Restaurant. Choose between our Land & Sea or Vegetarian menu, elevate the experience with a wine pairing, and begin the evening with a festive cocktail during our early-evening cocktail service. Then, as the night deepens, let live music carry you toward midnight and into the first moments of 2027. A MEDITERRANEAN NEW YEAR’S EVE IN UBUD Whether you are celebrating with your partner, gathering with friends, or sharing the occasion with family, The Midnight Fire offers a relaxed yet festive way to welcome the new year. Expect generous flavors, thoughtful craftsmanship, fire-kissed dishes, handcrafted drinks, live music, and an atmosphere designed for lingering long after dinner is finished. This is New Year’s Eve in Ubud, the Embers way — warm, flavorful, and made for memorable moments. a077bee4d5005d8bd6d7867d56de5f622156952d.description: On Friday, 20 November 2026, a special culinary collaboration will take place between Black Garlic at Adiwana Alas Harum and Dapur Bali Mula, as the two culinary establishments present Rooted in Bali. A one-night dining event, Rooted in Bali celebrates Balinese culinary and cultural heritage through thoughtfully prepared dishes, storytelling, and the performing arts, offering guests a deeper understanding and appreciation of the island’s culinary roots and the traditions that continue to shape its identity. When it comes to food, there is a common thread shared universally: it tells the story of place, its people, and the traditions passed down through generations. In Bali, culinary heritage is deeply rooted in local ingredients, age-old cooking methods, and knowledge preserved within village communities.

0c998371382e6c3c83a4032bb713f94cc6e02dc4.name: Bali 1928: A Musical Journey Back in Time at Desa Potato Head
0c998371382e6c3c83a4032bb713f94cc6e02dc4.description: Bali’s extraordinary and otherworldly culture was once the island’s most enticing allure. Before beaches and resorts, it was dance, art, music and ceremony that captured the imagination – a vibrant way of life that intertwined nature and ritual into the everyday. The year was 1928, and such was this cultural fascination that German record labels Odeon and Beka sent engineers to Bali to capture a sound quite like anything they had heard before: the rhythmic reverberations of the gamelan, and the ethereal voices of Balinese song. Around this time, pioneering researchers like the ethnomusicologist Colin McPhee, artist and author Miguel Covarrubias, and art collector Rolf de Maré captured silent film footage of ceremonies, dancers and everyday life. For decades these lay in archives, unseen and unheard by those depicted. Fast forward to 2013. Dr. Edward Herbst, Arbiter of Cultural Traditions New York, together with ITB STIKON Bali, began a repatriation project, Arsip Bali 1928 , scoping the world for these recordings and bringing them back to Bali.

5ab53ecef3f858ae33528468b77bde19108ebb8e.name: Beautiverse 2026: Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing
5ab53ecef3f858ae33528468b77bde19108ebb8e.description: From 18-20 December, Beautiverse 2026 returns to Bali, once again taking place at The Meru Sanur – Bali Beach Convention Centre, under the theme ‘Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing.’ This year, Beautiverse explores the evolution of the beauty industry towards a more holistic, conscious, and technology-driven approach. Over the three-day event, visitors can experience brand showcases, expert-led discussions, networking opportunities, and curated activities. The event also provides a platform for industry stakeholders to exchange ideas, build partnerships, and explore new opportunities across the beauty and wellness sectors. Featuring AI Ambassadors Tara, Bea, and Vexa as key highlights, Beautiverse introduces an innovative digital dimension to the experience. Beyond engaging audiences, these digital ambassadors reflect the growing relationship between artificial intelligence and the beauty and wellness industries. The Beautiverse App complements this initiative by providing information on the event, participating brands, programmes, and activities, creating a more interactive experience for visitors.

7b867e7d457fc4d9a977dc6058e28dc97a46a855.name: Padma Musical Series: George Harliono & Hera Hyesang Park
7b867e7d457fc4d9a977dc6058e28dc97a46a855.description: The Padma Musical Series returns this December with an evening of classical music featuring two acclaimed international artists: British-Indonesian pianist George Harliono and Korean soprano Hera Hyesang Park. Returning to Bali following his previous appearance at Padma Resort Legian, Harliono has established an impressive international career from a remarkably young age. In 2023, he received the Silver Medal at the XVII International Tchaikovsky Competition, one of the most prestigious events in the classical music world. His performance history includes celebrated venues such as Wigmore Hall, Royal Albert Hall, Berlin Philharmonie Kammermusiksaal and Suntory Hall, alongside appearances with orchestras including the NHK Symphony Orchestra, Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra and Mariinsky Orchestra. Joining him for the December performance is Hera Hyesang Park, making her Bali debut. A Deutsche Grammophon recording artist and graduate of The Juilliard School, the Korean soprano has performed at leading opera houses and concert halls around the world, including the Metropolitan Opera, Staatsoper Berlin, Paris Opéra and Glyndebourne Festival. Her repertoire spans celebrated works including La bohème , La traviata , Don Giovanni and Le nozze di Figaro . Her debut album, I Am Hera , was released in 2020, followed by Breathe , which received the 2024 Opus Klassik Award for Videoclip of the Year.

Held from 6pm to 10pm at the Kecak Ballroom , the evening will bring together Bali’s hospitality and business communities, philanthropists, government representatives, media and influencers for a night of food, entertainment and purposeful giving. Last year’s gala, An Evening of Elegance & Empathy, raised IDR 500 million for Bali Life Foundation . The contribution helped fund a new school in Southwest Sumba, which was officially inaugurated in July 2026. Today, that school stands as a lasting reminder of what collective generosity can achieve.
